title: feat(create-objectstack): ship a starter app and the note list view in the blank template
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLcR66HDKGmkegYSEN3PSwY)_

Fixes #32152

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 谁受益：每个用 `npm create objectstack` 新建项目的用户，第一次打开 Console 就能看到自己的项目。
- 之前：Console 只列出平台自带的 Setup、Account，示例 Note 对象没有任何入口，README 还要花一整节解释“这不是装坏了”。
- 现在：模板自带一个名为 Main 的 app（导航里有 Notes）和 Notes 列表视图，实测 `/api/v1/meta/app` 列出 `my_app_main_app`，排在 Setup、Account 前面。
- 文件来源：用仓库自己的 `os g app main --object note` 与 `os g view note` 生成，只把对象引用改成 `Note.name`，因为脚手架改名只改 `name:` 字面量。
- README 的 Console 一节缩短为“如何再加对象或 app”，删除示例对象的步骤补上视图和 app 条目。
- 不在本 PR：`os init` 的三个模板有同样的缺口（只写对象），建议另开卡。

## What changes

- `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/src/apps/main.app.ts` (new): the starter app `blank_main_app` (label `Main`), one navigation entry `Notes` on the sample object. `src/views/note.view.ts` (new): the sample object's list view (`All Notes`, columns `title`, `body`, sorted by title, 25 per page). Both barrels gain the one export line the generator writes, and drop their placeholder `export {};`.
- **Which way the files were made:** generated by running the repo's own writers, built from this branch, against a copy of the template: `objectstack generate app main --object note` and `objectstack generate view note`. The output was kept verbatim except for one deviation: the generator types the object's name out (`objectName: 'blank_note'`, `object: 'blank_note'`, `id: 'blank_note_nav'`), and scaffolding renames the namespace by rewriting `name: 'blank_…'` literals only (`rewriteObjectNamePrefix`). A typed-out `blank_note` would ship into `my-app` pointing at an object that is `my_app_note` there. So the app and view import `Note` and use `Note.name` (and `` `${Note.name}_nav` ``), the same rule `note.test.ts` already follows. Widening the rewrite itself was outside this card's file surface.
- `src/objects/note.object.ts`: the "to remove it" comment now names the view and the app entry too.
- `README.md`: "The Console — this starter ships no app" becomes "The Console": the project's app is listed beside Setup and Account; the rule (an object appears in Console navigation only when an app lists it) stays; how to add another object or app (`objectstack generate app NAME --object OBJECT`, `objectstack generate view OBJECT`). The sample-object steps gain step 2 (delete the view and the app entry). The Layout list names the app and the view.
- `blank-template-console-disclosure.test.ts`: header rewritten to record the new state and cite #32152 (the earlier "DELIBERATE" note was a dev's design note; the maintainer's card supersedes it, per the seat's ruling). The one-way "ships objects only" case becomes "ships the starter app and the sample object's list view". The bidirectional README check stays and, with an app present, now also requires the Console path, the app→navigation rule and the app file's name. New case: outside a `name:` literal, the template's namespace prefix is never written in its `src/` (the precondition the scaffolder's rename relies on).
- `starter-comments-self-contained.test.ts`: its sixth pattern (`../` paths) carried a written trigger: "a template grows an intra-project relative climb … the fix is the depth judgement — never an exemption for the file, and never a widened pattern". The app and view's `../objects/note.object.js` is exactly that, so the depth judgement is now in: every `../` run is still matched and resolved from the writing file's directory, and is a hit only when it lands outside that file's project. The pattern table gained a type, and the lookup is a stateless helper (the exclusion-liveness case shares it).
- `.changeset/32152-blank-starter-app.md`: patch for `create-objectstack`.

- **`content/docs/getting-started/your-first-project.mdx`**: the generated tree and the Console callout now show the starter app and view. This PR made the old "ships no app" text false (os-dev rule 3).
- **`packages/cli/test/create-objectstack-wiring-parity.test.ts`**: it required the apps and views barrels to be byte-identical to the empty barrel `os init` writes. It now requires that barrel as the prefix, followed only by `export { default as X } from './Y';` lines, with a vacuity case naming the two appended lines. The barrels are back to the generator's exact bytes.
- **`packages/cli/test/starter-field-consumers.e2e.test.ts`** (nightly): its control (strip `group`, expect `field-no-consumers`) went vacuous for the blank leg, because the new list view displays `title` and `body`. The control now also unwires the views the starter ships (their export lines only).

## Why

Card #32152 (filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」): a newcomer opens the Console the dev banner points to and sees nothing they made.

## Verification

Live, from this branch's built `create-objectstack` (published 18.3.0 dependencies from npm):

```
create-objectstack my-app --skip-skills         -> exit 0 (install ran)
src/apps/main.app.ts: name 'my_app_main_app', objectName: Note.name; note.object.ts: name 'my_app_note'
pnpm validate   -> exit 0   "UI: 1 Apps  1 Views"
pnpm typecheck  -> exit 0
pnpm test       -> exit 0   (1 passed)
pnpm lint       -> exit 0   "All checks passed"
pnpm dev --port <free>  ->  /api/v1/ready 200
GET /api/v1/meta/app (admin) ->
  my_app_main_app "Main"  nav [my_app_note]
  setup "Setup", account "Account"
GET /api/v1/meta/view/my_app_note -> 200, list "All Notes", columns title/body, _diagnostics.valid true
GET /_console/ -> 200
```

The issue's own measurement before this change: `GET /api/v1/meta/app` -> `[setup, account]` only.

Package suite (head `89e50c26`): `pnpm --filter create-objectstack exec vitest run` 25 files, 379 tests passed; `pnpm --filter create-objectstack typecheck` exit 0; `eslint --no-inline-config` on the 7 touched `.ts` files exit 0.

### Pins and their ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty)

| Ablation | Test | Result |
|---|---|---|
| `objectName: Note.name` -> `objectName: 'blank_note'` in `main.app.ts` | "reaches the sample object by `Note.name`" | red: `expected [ Array(1) ] to deeply equal []` |
| README heading back to `## The Console — this starter ships no app` | "discloses that no app means no Console navigation" | red: README matched `/ships no app/` |
| comment `../../../content/docs` added to `main.app.ts` (escapes the project from `src/apps/`) | starter-comments assertion 1 | red: "cites a path that climbs out of the scaffolded project" |
| `([docs](../../content/docs))` added to the project-root `README.md` | starter-comments assertion 1 | red, same message |

A first try of the third row used `../../content/docs` from `src/apps/`, which lands at the project root's `content/docs`, inside the project, and stayed green: that is the depth judgement working, not a vacuous gate, so it was redone with a path that really escapes. A first try of the fourth row was refused by `ablation-replace` (its replacement contained the anchor) and ran nothing; redone with another anchor.

### Gates

Derived set from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `89e50c26` (9 changed paths vs merge base `8523ef9a`): 60 families, run serially, each exit captured before any pipe. 59 exit 0. 1 NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, untouched packages such as `@objectstack/organizations` have no `dist` in this worktree); CI's lint job measures it. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` exit 0: "60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 59 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". The repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the Test Core / repo vitest project are CI's runs.

### Not done here

- The e2e boot probe (`scaffold-e2e-boot-probe.test.ts`) pins the `.github/workflows/scaffold-e2e.yml` boot block; an `/api/v1/meta/app` assertion would go in that workflow, a governed surface outside this card. The live run above stands in for it.
- `os init` (`packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts`): all three templates write objects only (`src/objects/*`), so they share this gap. Left for a follow-up card.
